correctness.rationale: For r redundant identical fields sigma_j=r^-1/2 ∂theta on circle, the exact p-Ret angular step is sqrt(rh)U with U first coordinate of uniform S^{r-1}, same covariance generator 1/2 ∂theta². Fourier characteristic function rho_{r,k}=E cos(k sqrt(rh)U) has the stated Bessel integral, including cos(k sqrt h) at r=1, J0(k sqrt(2h)) at r=2 and sinc(k sqrt(3h)) at r=3. For r>=2, U has an interval density, so |rho_{r,k}|<1 for each nonzero k and rho->0 by Riemann–Lebesgue; supremum q<1 is achieved and ||P^n−Π||=q^n. Bessel decay O(|k|^{-(r−1)/2}) makes the two-step point-start density L² (sum |rho|^4<∞), yielding exponential total variation convergence and bounded inverse of I−P on mean-zero L². At r=1 cos multipliers have supremum modulus 1 by rational resonance or irrational Kronecker density, point-start laws atomic hence TV=1, rational cases nonergodic and irrational cases strong L² but no norm mixing; small divisors exhibit continuous mean-zero forcing with no L² Poisson solution. Inspected actual check.py; independent reasoning verified the sphere-coordinate moment E U²=1/r and r1/r3 special multipliers. The r=1 fair sign is a mathematical edge case, not an assertion of paper sampler implementation.
